PlanEdge.description: One dependency edge of a Plan's graph: `from_spec` must land before `to_spec` may begin.

from_spec.description: The Spec that must land first.

PlanState.description: The closed Plan lifecycle vocabulary on the wire.

description: The Plan record as every client sees it: the lifecycle state, the working display order, and the working dependency graph.

edges.description: The dependency edges, held separately from the display order.

number.description: The number this Project minted for this Plan; rendered with the Project's code, for example `CORE-P1`.

project_id.description: The Project this Plan belongs to.

spec_numbers.description: The display order: the member Spec numbers as a per-Plan sequence.

version.description: The aggregate version, for optimistic mutation checks.
